outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic-style diagram showing calculated percentage contribution of illumination overhead per exposure setting, not an average across replicates with error bars — no individual data points are applicable.
Line plot (photobleaching decay curves) with shaded mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Scatter plot (ΔROS vs exposure time) with error bars; scatter plots inherently show individual data points.
Migration track line plots showing individual cell paths; each line already represents an individual data trace, not an averaged summary requiring point overlay.
Bar chart of migration speed (mean±s.e.m.) has individual data points (dots) overlaid for each cell.
Panel F consists of micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a micrograph time-series, not a plot.
Panel H is a micrograph time-series, not a plot.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from individual point overlay requirements.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from individual point overlay requirements.
